body:
Track 5 follow-up: applies the patch-averaged stress measure from `simdesign-patchstress` to the `simdesign-holes` strip and compares it with Kirsch's analytic field. Main finding: for a smooth hole the pointwise peak is already nearly settled (0.3% over the last refinement), the patch matches Kirsch's disc averages within 0.4% at d/W = 0.05, and it reads 65–91% of the peak. One coarse-mesh outlier is reported undiagnosed. 6 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
